# Reviewer (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`reviewer`](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The three-step "Reviewer access" dialog (role, purposes, notes plus Turnstile) that starts a reviewer session from the public site ([reviewer flow](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md)). D21 removes reviewer mode from web; this module goes with feature web-bff-hardening, and its Turnstile widget moves to `features/auth`.

## Techniques

Client components. The request goes from the browser to cms-api; the reviewer token lives in memory only (gone on reload). The Turnstile script loads only while the widget is mounted, and a new `key` gives a fresh challenge (a token works once). The entry shows only for an anonymous visitor while the owner's switch is on and a site key is configured.

## Technologies

React, react-hook-form with Zod, Cloudflare Turnstile (explicit render), Axios, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `ReviewerAccessDialog`, `useReviewerEnabled`.

## Where to change what

Nothing new here: the module is due for removal (D21). Bug fixes only.
